# Reproducible AI API stability evidence

> JSONL observations, success rate, P50/P95 latency and HTTP error distributions.

## GPT-6.2 Astra / Sol launch (2026-11-18)

AIFast has added `gpt-6.2-astra` and `gpt-6.2-sol`. The [launch announcement](https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements) and [public catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing) agree: both are marked `available=true` with `openai` and `openai-response` endpoint types. Base URL: `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[OpenAI describes](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-2-astra-sol/) Astra as a model for demanding reasoning, coding and professional work, and Sol for everyday coding and agent workflows. Provider capabilities still need separate gateway checks. This update records the launch and catalog; it does not report paid inference or reliability tests.

[Check current models and groups](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gpt-6-2-launch&utm_content=AI-API-Stability-Tracker) · [Setup guide](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/guide/) · [Catalog evidence](https://kkwang4444.github.io/api-status/data/gpt-6-2.json)

## Gemini 4 Carbon launch (checked 2026-11-11)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements) of `gemini-4-carbon` on 2026-11-11. The [public catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing) marks it `available: true`, lists `gemini` and `openai` endpoint types, and includes groups `Aistudio-Gemini-2/3/4` and `Vertex-Gemini-2/3`. OpenAI-compatible Base URL: `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

This entry records the launch announcement and catalog check only. No authenticated inference request was run; it supplies no Carbon success rate, latency, stability benchmark or SLA. Streaming and tool calls need separate validation.

[Current model catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) · [Gemini integration guide](https://docs.aifast.hk/en/providers/gemini-api/) · [Check a gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/)

## Gemini 4 Argon launch (checked 2026-10-15)

AIFast [announced the listing](https://www.aifast.hk/api/status) of `gemini-4-argon` on 2026-10-14. The current [catalog](https://www.aifast.hk/pricing) marks it `available: true` and lists `gemini` and `openai` protocols. The OpenAI-compatible Base URL is `https://www.aifast.hk/v1`.

[Google's model documentation](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon) describes Argon as a flagship reasoning model for complex software engineering, mathematics, science and multi-step agents. Its 1,048,576-token unified context budget is shared by input, thinking and output. This is not a promise of 1M output through the gateway; Google's long decode requires a dedicated workflow.

This is listing and catalog evidence, not an inference test or stability benchmark. No authenticated inference request was run for this update, and it supplies no Argon success rate, latency result or long-term SLA. Check the current console for pricing and limits, then test protocol features independently.

[Check an existing gateway with a temporary, low-limit key](https://docs.aifast.hk/model-check/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=gemini-4-argon-launch&utm_content=stability-llms), then validate text, streaming and tools from your deployment network.

## Evidence rules

- Keep one raw request per JSONL line before summarizing.
- Record UTC time, exact model ID, region, network, status, elapsed time and request feature.
- Split text, streaming, tool-call and image workloads.
- Publish sample count, observation window, failure definition, P50/P95 and status distribution together.
- A smoke test is not a long-term availability result.

## Three distinct figures

- First-party product availability is an operator-published metric.
- Test-window success rate describes declared samples and conditions.
- Contractual SLA is defined by service terms and remedies.

These figures must not be substituted for one another. The bundled JSONL is synthetic format data, not AIFast production monitoring.

## Gemini 4 Hydrogen / Carbon catalog update (2026-11-17)

HK announced gemini-4-hydrogen on November 13 and gemini-4-carbon on November 11. Checked 2026-11-17: both are available=true with gemini/openai endpoint types. Base URL: https://www.aifast.hk/v1 . No measured samples were added. There are no Hydrogen or Carbon success-rate, P50/P95 or SLA results; sample each model, group and time window separately. No authenticated inference was run; this is not generation, SSE, tool-call or model-identity evidence.

Sources: https://www.aifast.hk/api/pricing and https://www.aifast.hk/api/announcements . Setup: https://docs.aifast.hk/en/providers/gemini-api/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repository&utm_campaign=integration-guide&utm_content=AI-API-Stability-Tracker-gemini-llms .
